title: U Mass - Basal Glucose Metabolism
author: Jason Kim
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xr8fm9w

steps.title: Perform Survival Surgery
steps.instruction: Establish a chronic indwelling catheter for intravenous infusion 5~6 days prior to the experiment (refer to M1023: Surgery-jugular vein cannulation).

steps.title: Fast Mice
steps.instruction: Fast mice overnight (~15 hours) or for 5 hours prior to the start of the experiment.

steps.title: Prepare Mouse for Infusion
steps.instruction: Secure the mouse and prepare the catheter for the infusion pump.

substeps.instruction: Place the mouse in a rat-size restrainer with its tail tape-tethered at one end.
Expose and flush the intravenous catheter using saline solution.
Connect the catheter to the CMA Microdialysis infusion pump.

steps.title: Collect Basal Plasma Sample
steps.instruction: Collect a 10 µl plasma sample before the start of infusion (basal-0 min) to measure basal glucose levels.

steps.title: Initiate Glucose Infusion
steps.instruction: Start the experiment by turning on the pump to intravenously infuse [3-³H] D-glucose (suspended in saline solution) at 0.05 µCi/min in awake mice.

steps.title: Collect Periodic Plasma Samples
steps.instruction: Collect plasma samples at 90, 100, 110, and 120 min for glucose and [3-³H] D-glucose measurements.

substeps.instruction: Collect 10 µl plasma samples at 90, 100, 110, and 120 min to measure glucose levels.
Collect additional 10 µl plasma samples at 90, 100, 110, and 120 min to measure [3-³H] D-glucose concentrations.
Suspend the 10 µl plasma samples for [3-³H] D-glucose in 20 µl distilled water (dH2O) to create 30 µl sample solutions.

steps.title: Euthanize Mice
steps.instruction: Euthanize mice using pentobarbital at the end of the experiment.

steps.title: Conduct Biochemical Assay
steps.instruction: Measure [3-³H] D-glucose concentrations using the collected plasma samples.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 15 µl of plasma sample solutions into clearly labeled microcentrifuge tubes.
Add 25 µl BaOH and vortex samples.
Add 25 µl Zn(SO)2 and vortex samples.
Centrifuge samples for 5 min at 12,000g (~14,000 rpm).
Transfer 20 µl of supernatant into scintillation vials and place in a vacuum oven at room temperature for overnight drying.
Add 80 µl dH2O and vortex thoroughly following overnight drying.
Add 3 ml of Ultima scintillation cocktail and vortex sample.
Measure [3-³H] D-glucose using a Beckman Coulter Scintillation Counter.

steps.title: Calculate Glucose Turnover
steps.instruction: Calculate the basal rate of whole body glucose turnover as the ratio of the [³H]glucose infusion rate to the specific activity of plasma glucose averaged for 90~120 min of the experiment.
